    Restriction of finite-dimensional linear modules #

    Precomposition along a linear functor whose source has finitely many objects restricts finite-dimensional modules to finite-dimensional modules.

      Restriction of finite linear modules preserves kernels. After forgetting the two full-subcategory layers, this is the pointwise fact that precomposition preserves limits.
